scope: Manual inspection of one delivered image against the source-visible target.
review_axes: photographic person versus flat drawn background
close upward view, chin lift, head and torso projected size
full crown, lower hem crop, right arm edge truncation
giant illustration scale and above-left smiling mouth with surviving side fragments
long dark hair, bangs, face features and asymmetric top with separate diagonal band
face-to-neck and shoulder light pattern, crown sheen and shallow garment gradient
near-black materials, muted pink-gray background and subdued warm skin
capture softness and lower-shirt detail floor
scoring: No calibrated numerical score or pass threshold declared. Qualitative retained/drifted/uncertain observations will be separated from structure validation.
measurement_limits: No calibrated neutral, illuminant, camera response or exact source rig; rendered backend size and model are not exposed by the tool interface.
